errors.text_span: като всички сектори са етикетирани с проценти вътре в тях, с изключение на трите по-малки
errors.evidence: The sentence is contradictory. It first claims that 'all sectors are labeled', and then immediately qualifies this with 'with the exception of the three smaller ones'. This phrasing is logically flawed and confusing. A clearer description would state that only the three largest sectors are labeled.
